title: Fair deal or trap?
summary: Spot pressure tricks in offers and sales talk.
objectives: Recognise urgency pressure and too-good claims
Practise asking one check question before buying
briefMarkdown:
## Mission

Traps often sound like:
- Only today!
- Everyone is buying!
- Guaranteed rich!

Fair deals can wait while you check.

quiz.prompt: "Buy now or lose 90% forever!" Best first move:

options.label: Buy instantly so you do not miss out
Pause and ask: what exactly do I get, and can I compare?
Share the offer to all chats uncritically

quiz.teachBack: Urgency is a common pressure trick. Checking is strength.

reflectionPrompt: Write one check question you will ask before your next purchase.

supported.coachNote: Show two ad examples: trap vs fair.

steady.coachNote: Ask what 'too good' looks like in their town.

fast.coachNote: Have them rewrite a trap ad into honest copy.

llm.tutorBrief: Consumer caution only. No brand attacks. No financial product recommendations.
